topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I stepped into the rain, collar up, hat brim down. The city's a blur of headlights and wet asphalt. Found out today my childhood friend doesn't remember a thing about me. Maybe it's the rain or the way the city feels when the night draws in, but I can't shake the thought that I should have checked in sooner. People change, memory fades, but you'd think the good times would stick around somewhere. I've seen how folks can turn their backs or just plain forget, but this feels... different. I should've been there, kept in touch. Now it's too late for those what-ifs. I light a cigarette, let the smoke fill the gap where our past used to be.
